release_notes: Improved resilience when Morsewurst is closed unexpectedly during an active practice.
Added practice-level database tracking so full practice series and their individual rounds can be analysed together.
Saved rounds are now linked to their parent practice, including round number and practice completion status.
Added handling for completed, stopped and interrupted practice sessions.
Improved database consistency checks for practice and round relationships.
Note: this version changes the local database structure. Automatic end-user database migration is not included. Existing users may need to reset their local database or apply a manual batch repair.
